## What's Changed
* Make Folio a first-class workspace mode by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/569
* Redesign collection and Kanban views by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/570
* Add full-width AI agent view by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/571
* Redesign database table view by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/572

* Add Excalidraw canvas support by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/580
* Add /canvas command to AI composer by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/581
* Reduce macOS image asset size (#582)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/582
